standfirst: This issue covers three Claude Code releases, Google's push to personalise Search, and a handful of ChatGPT demos and open-source tools you can try this week.
digest: Claude Code shipped three releases this week. Version 2.1.332 lets MCP servers offer skills, 2.1.331 adds Code Mode on Bedrock, Google Cloud and Foundry, and 2.1.330 adds a built-in mod that draws charts on request.

For a consultant, the Bedrock and Foundry support matters most when a client must keep AI inside its own cloud. Google also let users connect Wallet, Drive and Gemini to Search, so expect privacy questions about it.

On the tools side, Firecrawl, AFFiNE and AutoClip are the easiest to point a client at, though Firecrawl needs an engineer. The Watch section has short ChatGPT clips you can try in a minute, and a Fireship breakdown of Gemini 4 Neon.

items.title: Codex plugin turns a reference image into editable SVG and 3D
items.summary: A newcomer turns a reference image into an editable graphic and 3D model, then changes it by asking in plain language. Needs Codex.

items.title: Fireship explains why Gemini 4 Neon outscores Google's own flagship
items.summary: A short breakdown of Google's mid-tier model beating its three-week-old flagship. Useful context if clients ask which Gemini to use; no setup needed.

items.title: ChatGPT can check a price daily and tell you when it drops
items.summary: A short clip with a copyable prompt that asks ChatGPT to track an item's price and report drops. Takes a minute to try.

items.title: ChatGPT browses local sites and helps book a family day out
items.summary: Describe what you want and ChatGPT searches local information and helps with bookings. Consumer-focused, but shows the browsing agent in plain terms.

items.title: ChatGPT explains a photo and flags what to double-check
items.summary: Snap a photo and ask what you are looking at; ChatGPT also points out details worth verifying. Easy to try on a phone.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.332 adds skills from MCP servers in beta
items.summary: Skills offered by connected MCP servers now appear in the / menu as server:skill, plus a new hook that can block inline shell commands.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.331 supports Code Mode on Bedrock, Google Cloud and Foundry
items.summary: Terminal sessions on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud and Microsoft Foundry now get Code Mode. Relevant for clients who must run Claude through their own cloud.

items.title: Claude Code 2.1.330 adds easel, a built-in mod that draws charts
items.summary: Claude Code can now draw charts on request and under MCP metrics results, on Pro, Max and some Team plans on macOS and Linux.

items.title: Google Search can use Wallet, Drive and Gemini data in AI Mode
items.summary: Users can opt in to connect Google Wallet, Drive and the Gemini app so Search answers are more personal. Clients may ask about privacy.

sections.title: Tools and skills you can use

items.title: Firecrawl searches and scrapes web data through one API for agents
items.summary: Gives an AI agent search, scraping and access to 550+ data providers. Needs an API key and some setup, so ask an engineer.

items.title: AFFiNE is an open-source Notion and Miro alternative
items.summary: A privacy-first knowledge base combining planning, notes and whiteboards. Worth a look if clients want a self-hosted option. Some setup needed to self-host.

items.title: Twenty offers an open-source, AI-ready alternative to Salesforce
items.summary: A CRM built with AI in mind. Useful to see what an open Salesforce alternative looks like; self-hosting needs an engineer.

items.title: AutoClip cuts long podcasts and interviews into short videos locally
items.summary: Open-source desktop tool that generates clips, subtitles, covers and post copy from long videos. Handy for client content teams; runs on your own machine.

items.title: Edgeever is a free AI-native note app with a web clipper and MCP
items.summary: An Evernote and Obsidian alternative with MCP support so AI assistants can use your notes. Free to host on Cloudflare or Docker.

items.title: Google's Stitch skills add design tasks to Claude Code and other agents
items.summary: A library of agent skills for Google's Stitch design MCP server, working with Claude Code, Gemini CLI and Cursor. Needs the Stitch server set up.

items.title: Superpowers adds a structured skills workflow to coding agents
items.summary: A skills framework and working method for coding agents that is trending today. Install in Claude Code to try; best suited to technical users.

items.title: Google will make AI agents use its MCP servers, but Gmail can't send
items.summary: A write-up on Google Workspace's MCP servers and their gaps, with 267 comments on Hacker News. Useful before promising clients an email agent.

items.title: AI made self-hosting fun again, one developer writes
items.summary: A blogger's account of using AI to run their own services, which drew 545 points and 280 comments. Shows the do-it-yourself side of AI use.
